content.text: Based on the search results, I found the answer. Dame Stella Rimington was both the first female Director General of MI5 and the first DG whose name was publicized on appointment.

**Answer:** Stella Rimington

Dame Stella Rimington was appointed Director General of MI5 in 1992, becoming not only the first female DG but also the first DG whose name was publicly acknowledged (in 1993).
